title: fix(food): custom foods are private to their creator (UX-FOOD-PRIV-124, T4)
body:
## UX-FOOD-PRIV-124 — custom foods are private to their creator (T4: PII/health data, RLS, migration)

Operator decision C-396-3, promoted to B. One plain sentence: a client types in a custom food ("Grandma Rosa's lasagne", a label from home) and today every other client who searches "lasagne" sees it, can open it by id or barcode, and can log it, because `FoodItem` had no owner.

### What changes

- **Schema + migration `20270403000000_private_custom_foods`** (additive, no backfill, ships `down.sql`): nullable `FoodItem.created_by_user_id` FK to `User`, index, `ON DELETE CASCADE` (never `SET NULL`: a private row must never turn into a shared catalog row). Existing rows stay null and shared exactly as before.
- **Owner set only on the custom-food create path** (`POST /foods`, `req.user.id`). Seeded rows and USDA / OpenFoodFacts imports stay null-owned and shared.
- **Every read path is caller-scoped** (`src/food/food.service.ts`, `food.controller.ts`, `log.service.ts`):
  - search: the shared search cache now holds shared results only; the caller's own foods are read per request and merged (own first on a name tie, same relevance order as before). Empty-query defaults are `catalog OR own`.
  - by id: another person's custom food returns null, exactly like a missing id.
  - barcode (`GET /foods/barcode/:upc` and `off_<code>` on log): a row already holding the barcode answers directly; another person's custom food reads as not found (404).
  - logging: `resolveOrImportId` refuses another person's custom food with the same "not found" as a missing id; a custom food carrying a `usda:<id>` tag never stands in for that USDA import (lookup filters `created_by_user_id: null`).
- **RLS** (FoodItem keeps ENABLE + FORCE; service_role and owner-only write policies unchanged): `p_fooditem_select` (public, incl. anon) narrowed from `USING (true)` to `created_by_user_id IS NULL`; new `p_fooditem_select_own` (authenticated) for the creator and the owner role. anon calls no helper function.
- **Deletion**: erasure manifest deletes `LoggedFoodEntry` via `food_item.created_by_user_id` (RESTRICT child first), then `FoodItem.created_by_user_id`. Covered by the schema-driven coverage, seeded-execution and FK-order suites.
- **Export**: `custom_foods` section (the user's own custom foods, oldest first, owner column omitted); README row.

### Tests

- `test/food-custom-privacy.spec.ts`: real FoodService/FoodController/LogService over an in-memory FoodItem table whose local search reads the composed SQL. B cannot find A's food by search (both pg_trgm and ILIKE paths, including from the cache A's search filled), by id, by barcode, or by logging its id or `off_` barcode id; A can; A's logged entry carries the food's nutrition; a `usda:` tagged custom food never stands in for the import; imports stay unowned; create records the creator.
- `test/rls/food-item-custom-privacy-rls.spec.ts` (new step in `rls-live-tests`): tier-3 FoodItem RLS verbatim + this migration verbatim on real Postgres; creator sees own + catalog, another client / no-GUC API caller / anon see the catalog only (no error), owner role and service_role see all, writes stay owner-only.
- `test/data-export-archive-inventory.spec.ts`: `custom_foods` exports only the user's own, oldest first, without the owner column.
- Existing food specs updated for the caller argument.

### Deploy (operator)

Deploy with **`migrations=apply-migrations`**, together with or after the already-merged #765 (main already contains it). No backfill, no production data change; the migration takes a brief lock on `FoodItem`/`User` (`lock_timeout 5s`). No mobile change is needed: the app already calls these endpoints as the signed-in client.

### Size

Changed lines: see the PR header (under 1,500; tests count). No lockfile, generated file or dependency change.

**B=1, U=0, C=2**

- **B-PRIV-1 (operator C-396-3, promoted to B):** a client types in a custom food, and every other client who searches for it sees it, can open it by id or barcode and can log it, because `FoodItem` had no owner. Fixed: `FoodItem.created_by_user_id` (set only by `POST /foods`), and search (including the shared search cache), `GET /foods/:id`, `GET /foods/barcode/:upc`, and logging by id or `off_<barcode>` serve a custom food only to its creator. Another person's custom food reads exactly like a missing id. The shared catalog and USDA/OpenFoodFacts imports stay null-owned and visible as before. In the same exposure: the search cache now holds shared results only (it could carry one person's custom food to another), and a custom food tagged `usda:<id>` can no longer stand in for that USDA import.
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): a custom food created with a real product's barcode holds that barcode (the column is globally unique), so other clients get 404 for it instead of the OpenFoodFacts product. API-only; the app has no scanner.
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients): same-instant race between the barcode pre-check and the upsert.

**Migration `20270403000000_private_custom_foods`** (additive, no backfill, ships `down.sql`): nullable column + index + FK `ON DELETE CASCADE` (never SET NULL: a private row must never become a shared catalog row). RLS: `p_fooditem_select` (public/anon) narrowed from `USING (true)` to `created_by_user_id IS NULL`; new `p_fooditem_select_own` (authenticated) for the creator and owner role; anon calls no helper; writes and service_role unchanged.

**Deletion:** erasure manifest deletes `LoggedFoodEntry` via `food_item.created_by_user_id` (RESTRICT child first), then `FoodItem.created_by_user_id`. **Export:** new `custom_foods` section (own rows only, oldest first, owner column omitted) + README row.

+-- UX-FOOD-PRIV-124: custom foods are private to the person who created them.
+--
+-- Additive only. Reverse: down.sql. No backfill: every existing row keeps a
+-- null owner and stays in the shared catalog exactly as before.
+--
+-- "FoodItem"."created_by_user_id": set only by the custom-food create path
+-- (POST /foods). Seeded rows and USDA / OpenFoodFacts imports stay null-owned
+-- and shared. The backend serves an owned row only to its creator; the
+-- account-deletion manifest deletes it with the account, so a private row
+-- never becomes a shared catalog row. ON DELETE CASCADE (never SET NULL) for
+-- the same reason: the User row is tombstoned, but if a User row were ever
+-- removed its private foods must go with it rather than turn public.
+--
+-- RLS (FoodItem stays ENABLE + FORCE from 20261213000000_rls_tier3_nutrition;
+-- service_role and the owner-only write policies are unchanged):
+--   * p_fooditem_select (public, including anon): only the shared catalog,
+--     created_by_user_id IS NULL. Was USING (true).
+--   * p_fooditem_select_own (authenticated): the creator's own rows, plus the
+--     platform owner, through the existing app.current_user_id() and
+--     app.is_owner() helpers. anon is not named, so no helper is called for it.
+
+SET lock_timeout = '5s';
+
+-- 1) Owner column, index and FK (the shape prisma generates for schema.prisma)
+ALTER TABLE "FoodItem" ADD COLUMN "created_by_user_id" TEXT;
+
+CREATE INDEX "FoodItem_created_by_user_id_idx" ON "FoodItem"("created_by_user_id");
+
+ALTER TABLE "FoodItem" ADD CONSTRAINT "FoodItem_created_by_user_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("created_by_user_id") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;
+
+-- 2) RLS: the shared catalog stays readable; a custom food is its creator's only
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_fooditem_select" ON "FoodItem";
+CREATE POLICY "p_fooditem_select" ON "FoodItem" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO public USING ("created_by_user_id" IS NULL);
+COMMENT ON POLICY "p_fooditem_select" ON "FoodItem" IS 'UX-FOOD-PRIV-124: the shared food catalog (seeded, USDA FDC and OpenFoodFacts imports; created_by_user_id IS NULL) stays readable by any caller. A custom food (created_by_user_id set) is never readable through this policy.';
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "p_fooditem_select_own" ON "FoodItem";
+CREATE POLICY "p_fooditem_select_own" ON "FoodItem" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (("created_by_user_id" = app.current_user_id()) OR app.is_owner());
+COMMENT ON POLICY "p_fooditem_select_own" ON "FoodItem" IS 'UX-FOOD-PRIV-124: a custom food is readable only by the user who created it (and the platform owner role). Writes stay app.is_owner() / service_role only.';
